name: aliimagepull
description: AliImagePull macOS Electron app for deterministic AliExpress image extraction and download

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aliimagepull/core && npm run build -w @aliimagepull/electron-main && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @aliimagepull/renderer" "wait-on tcp:5173 && RENDERER_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron apps/electron-main/dist/main.js"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aliimagepull/core && npm run build -w @aliimagepull/renderer && npm run build -w @aliimagepull/electron-main
